name: overleaf-private
description: Read, edit and compile the Overleaf project connected to your private service.

interface.longDescription: Work with the connected Overleaf project through your private Cloudflare service. Supports reading, text and section edits with revision checks, text file creation, and compilation. OAuth sign-in and a saved Overleaf session are required.
interface.defaultPrompt: Read my connected Overleaf project and help me edit it.
